paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on the PopQA task as a function of s_pop frequency, which is scaled by 10^4 and ranges from 1 to 19 on the x-axis. The x-axis is linear, with tick marks at every 2 units (1, 3, 5, ..., 19), and is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)". The y-axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear increments of 0.2, and is labeled "Accuracy". Two lines are shown: a blue dashed line with circular markers and error bars, and a green solid line with square markers and error bars. The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.7 at s_pop frequency 1, rises to about 0.95 at frequency 5, remains near 0.95 through frequency 11, dips slightly to around 0.9 at frequency 13, and then rises back to 1.0 at frequency 17 and 19. The green solid line begins at approximately 0.3 at frequency 1, increases to about 0.6 at frequency 5, dips to around 0.4 at frequency 9, rises again to 0.6 at frequency 11, drops to about 0.5 at frequency 13, and then sharply increases to 1.0 at frequency 17 and 19. Error bars are present for both lines, indicating variability in the accuracy measurements.
